vedic_reference.note: This name is derived from the Sanskrit word बांक (bank), which means 'to sit' or 'to worship'. The suffix किम् (kim) is a diminutive suffix, making the name mean 'one who sits and worships Vishnu' or simply 'worshiper of Vishnu'. The name is also considered to be a reference to Lord Vishnu himself.
